positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Involved in identifying the requirements to automate manual tasks using RPA and Bizagi
Identifying and analysis of present manual processing and to-be process and check compatibility of business applications with tools
Worked with extraction of data from databases like MS Access which act as back-end data storage for uploaded files in SharePoint
Used email automation commands for retrieving and sending mails to the employees and QA testing team
Created database connections to fetch the data and automated the process to arrange data
Worked on creation and manipulation of collections for data of tabular format
Created and configured utility bots and template bots which are reusable amongst other Projects
Efficiently handled monitoring and troubleshooting the Blue Prism environment through Control room
Performed UAT testing alongside business users for RPA and BPM Projects
Provided Exception handling at every possible scenario for a robust error-free development
Responsible for maintaining the Functional Requirement document, Solution design and technical design documents.
Automated Time Sensitive Complex Processes for Banking, Mortgage, Payroll Services, Healthcare and Fashion Industry Clients
Automated Microsoft Power Apps, MS Office Apps, Adobe Acrobat Reader, Mainframe Application Like NASCO and Nuance Pdf Applications to Support Client on Complex Processes
Automated Credit Card Deactivation, Secure Email, Deceased Depositor, Account Closure, Customer Validation and Nautilus Processes for A Banking Client
Automated Mortgage Client’s Processes Involving Collateral Nexus and Encompass Applications
Developed Automations on Government Portals Like Hud, Sam and Treasury Check Verifications Using Browser Automation Mode
Developed Automations on Transaction Management, Blue squared, Blue Images, NASCO eFDE And IKA Systems for Healthcare Clients to Automate Their Claims Processes
Developed Automations Using Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio for Backend Processes
positions.insights: Analytical Skills, Blue Prism and +18 skills

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Worked in an agile team environment with other Software Development Engineers in Amazon Web Services’ CodeDeploy team to develop and maintain the product.

Actively involved in Analysis, Design, Development, System end to end testing. Successfully followed agile methodology in the Scrum Cycle model.

Directed the flow of Planning, Modelling, Construction, Deployment, and Communication that were met up as per the needs of the project.

Worked on time critical projects like GDPR and FedRamp to make our product complaint with International Rules and regulations.

Involved in back-end development using Java/J2EE technologies, Amazon Web Services and Ruby on Rails.

Developed essential Operational tools to handle operational events using Python and Java languages.

Developed the responsive UI web pages using HTML5, CSS3, XML, JavaScript, and has worked with Angular JS filters in expressions and directives to filter data in the UI.
